title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #18 (Term 3)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #18 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What can you do to memorise a dua? (1 mark)
   A. Never practise
   B. Read it once
   C. Repeat it line by line with a partner
   D. Sleep on it

2. What do we say when entering the house? (1 mark)
   A. Tawakkaltu 'alallah
   B. Subhanallah
   C. Only Amin
   D. Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Rabbina tawakkalna

3. Which verse tells us to greet when entering homes? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 110:1
   B. Qur'an 24:61
   C. Qur'an 112:1
   D. Qur'an 1:2

4. What is dua? (1 mark)
   A. Calling upon Allah and asking Him
   B. A type of food
   C. A game
   D. A journey

5. What is muamalat? (1 mark)
   A. A fast
   B. A journey
   C. The way people deal with each other
   D. A prayer

6. What can a child do if parents are poor and cannot buy everything? (1 mark)
   A. Steal
   B. Be patient and make dua for them
   C. Refuse to speak
   D. Complain loudly

7. Which shows disobedience? (1 mark)
   A. Slamming doors and refusing to help
   B. Speaking softly
   C. Greeting parents
   D. Helping with dishes

8. What is the dua for parents? (1 mark)
   A. Bismillah
   B. Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
   C. Subhanallah
   D. Amin

9. What does "uff" mean in Qur'an 17:23? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A song
   C. A word of impatience
   D. A greeting

10. When should we not obey parents? (1 mark)
   A. When they command something Allah forbids
   B. When they ask for water
   C. When they ask us to study
   D. When they call us

11. Which is a bad habit toward relatives? (1 mark)
   A. Gossiping about them
   B. Visiting them
   C. Greeting them
   D. Helping them

12. What is silat ar-rahm? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping family ties
   B. Praying
   C. Trading
   D. Fasting

13. Which greeting is used with relatives? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting
   B. As-salamu alaykum
   C. Insults
   D. Silence

14. What should a child do to a cousin who has more toys? (1 mark)
   A. Break them
   B. Take them
   C. Be happy for them, not envy
   D. Envy them

15. Which is a way to apply the first verses? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid school
   B. Read and study daily
   C. Ignore books
   D. Skip reading

16. What is the Night of the first revelation often connected with? (1 mark)
   A. Hajj
   B. Mawlid
   C. Laylat al-Qadr
   D. Eid

17. Apart from Ibrahim, whose children were all the Prophet's children? (1 mark)
   A. Khadija's
   B. Safiyya's
   C. Hafsa's
   D. Aisha's

18. Who was the first person to believe in the Prophet's message? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Bakr
   B. Bilal
   C. Ali
   D. Khadija

19. Why did the Prophet go to Taif? (1 mark)
   A. To trade
   B. To invite people to Islam
   C. To relax
   D. To hide

20. What should you do if you fail a test? (1 mark)
   A. Give up
   B. Study more and try again
   C. Cheat
   D. Blame others

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Why is Laylat al-Qadr connected to the first revelation? (3 marks)

22. Explain why parents should be fair among their children. (3 marks)

23. State three virtues the Prophet showed in Taif. (3 marks)

24. Explain the role of Abu Bakr (R.A.) in the growth of Islam. (4 marks)

25. State four teachings from the first five verses of Surah Al-Alaq. (4 marks)

26. Why is it important for parents to fulfil their obligations? (3 marks)

27. What should a child do when two cousins quarrel? (3 marks)

28. Suggest four situations in which a Grade 4 child needs patience, tolerance or perseverance. (4 marks)

29. Write the meaning of the dua for leaving the house. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #18 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Repeat it line by line with a partner
   Practice helps.

2. D — Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Rabbina tawakkalna
   This is the dua for entering.

3. B — Qur'an 24:61
   Surah An-Nur 24:61.

4. A — Calling upon Allah and asking Him
   Dua means supplication.

5. C — The way people deal with each other
   Muamalat covers social relations.

6. B — Be patient and make dua for them
   Understand their situation.

7. A — Slamming doors and refusing to help
   Rudeness is wrong.

8. B — Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
   A dua asking mercy for parents.

9. C — A word of impatience
   Do not say even "uff".

10. A — When they command something Allah forbids
   Obedience is in what is good.

11. A — Gossiping about them
   Gossip breaks ties.

12. A — Keeping family ties
   Ties of kinship.

13. B — As-salamu alaykum
   A Muslim greeting.

14. C — Be happy for them, not envy
   Do not envy.

15. B — Read and study daily
   Apply the command to read.

16. C — Laylat al-Qadr
   Surah 97 speaks about it.

17. A — Khadija's
   All his children except Ibrahim were from Khadija.

18. D — Khadija
   Khadija was first.

19. B — To invite people to Islam
   He wanted support.

20. B — Study more and try again
   Perseverance.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Qur'an says it was sent down on the Night of Power in Ramadan, which is why Ramadan is special.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Night of Power, 1 mark for Ramadan, 1 mark for the Qur'an.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Prophet told parents to fear Allah and be fair among children. Favouring one causes jealousy and hurt.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the teaching, 1 mark for jealousy, 1 mark for fairness.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Patience, tolerance, perseverance, mercy, trust in Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: He believed at once, invited others, spent his wealth freeing believers, and was the Prophet's companion in the cave.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four roles.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Seek knowledge; read in Allah's name; Allah is the Creator and Most Generous; writing is important; we learn what we did not know.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Children grow safe and well-behaved, the family and community are strong, and parents earn Allah's reward.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stay calm, encourage them to forgive and make peace, and ask an elder if needed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for calm, 1 mark for peace, 1 mark for asking elders.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Being teased, failing a test, a friend refusing to play, being sick, dealing with a rude neighbour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each suitable situation.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might and no power except with Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three parts.
